intro: ErgoNest is built on a simple but powerful idea — two people sharing a bed shouldn't have to compromise on comfort. With an incline control and intelligent storage, it redefines modern bedrooms.

features.title: Individual mattress incline control for personalised rest
features.text: Each side of the bed adjusts independently between 3 and 60 degrees using a dedicated RF remote, letting one person read upright while the other sleeps flat. Beyond convenience, the incline feature actively supports back pain relief, reduces acid reflux, and helps ease sleep apnea symptoms including snoring.

features.title: Motorised lift-up storage for effortless storage access
features.text: A single press of the button on the headboard ledge engages the motor and raises the entire mattress base, opening up approximately 845 litres of storage beneath. The mechanism only operates on a continuous press, stopping immediately when released — a deliberate safety feature that prevents accidental closure.

features.title: Floating integrated side tables for a seamless, uncluttered look
features.text: The side tables extend directly from the headboard on both sides, keeping the visual line of the bed clean and continuous. Each comes with two soft-close, push-to-open drawers — enough surface and storage for everything that lives beside your bed, without the mess of standalone furniture.

features.title: Built-in charging on both sides for a cable-free bedside
features.text: The headboard integrates a 3-pin socket, a USB-C port, and a USB-A port on each side, so both users can charge phones, tablets, or laptops without cables draping across the bed. Everything charges where it sits, invisibly.

features.title: Motion-sensing night lamps for gentle, automatic illumination
features.text: The side table lamps activate the moment someone steps out of bed or enters the room, guiding them without switching on the main lights. It is a small detail that makes a real difference during late-night moments when bright lights are the last thing anyone needs.

features.title: Raised platform for a floating, elevated look
features.text: The 4-inch measured floor clearance creates a light, suspended appearance that adds visual depth to the bed frame. It also keeps the space beneath open and accessible, making cleaning and maintenance straightforward.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
